## Catalog change

Briefly describe the paper/resource addition, correction, or tooling change.

## Source and provenance

List the primary pages used to verify metadata, ownership, availability, and license terms.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the inclusion criteria and selected the appropriate scope.
- [ ] Paper metadata and resource claims come from primary sources.
- [ ] Official and community resources are labeled accurately.
- [ ] Missing resources use an explicit `not-found` or `not-released` status; no URL or license was guessed.
- [ ] Every changed record has an accurate, quoted `last_verified` date.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/catalog.py validate`.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/catalog.py generate` and committed generated pages.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/catalog.py generate --check`.
- [ ] I considered the separate CC BY 4.0 content and MIT code license boundaries.
